outcomes.item: `game.ts` no longer owns deed/rumor propagation, hostile spawning, pressure-cap pruning, or autonomous NPC turn policy logic; those seams now live under `engine/systems/`.
`packages/engine/src/escape-the-dungeon/engine/systems/history.ts` now owns deed semantic vectorization and rumor sharing in addition to dialogue progress and event recording.

`packages/engine/src/escape-the-dungeon/engine/systems/pressure.ts` now owns hostile spawn cadence/caps and pressure-cap pruning, and `packages/engine/src/escape-the-dungeon/engine/systems/npc-turns.ts` owns NPC action-policy resolution and predator movement.
`GAME_STRUCTURE.md` now reflects the new runtime seam ownership so the architecture doc matches the extracted engine layout.

verification.command: pnpm --dir docs-site exec vitest run tests/unit/game-engine.test.ts

follow-ups.item: `game.ts` is now much closer to orchestration-only, but `62-02` still needs its stale parity/doc closeout status brought in line before phase 62 can be called fully complete.
